shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 5 'chartkit|yagr|charts|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '128,166p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls -a | head -18; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr'
/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select Switch Text Loader'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select Switch Text Loader'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json | tail -45 && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; rg -n -C 2 'options\\??:|value\\??:|onUpdate\\??:|label\\??:|size\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'base-positive|text-positive|line-positive|base-float|base-simple|base-info|text-info|line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit | rg '(plugins/.+index|types|ChartKit|settings).*\\.(d.ts|js)"'$'"' | head -45; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg 'docs/INDEX|types/(chart|series|axis)' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/{index.js,types.d.ts}; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; rg -n 'grid|ticks|labels|title|min\\??:|max\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr | rg '(config|series|axes).*d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js | head -105; rg -n -C 2 'interface RawSerie|type RawSerie|interface YagrConfig|axes\\??:|legend\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts; sed -n '40,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md | head -85; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/libs/settings/settings.d.ts; cat vite.config.ts; rg -n 'positive|info-medium|base-float' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'RawSerieData|YagrConfig|LegendConfig' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist | rg 'types' | head -20; rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text|line)-(positive["'^: ,;)]*|info[''^: ,;)]*|float[''^: ,;)]*)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -30; rg -n -A 45 'function shapeYagrConfig|const shapeYagrConfig' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js; sed -n '178,212p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'numberFormat|type FormatNumberOptions|interface FormatNumberOptions' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/*.d.ts; rg -n -C 2 'suffix|unit|scale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/format*.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "head -15 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n -A 65 'interface FormatNumberOptions|type FormatNumberOptions' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.js | head -100; rg -n 'timeMultiplier' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '190,210p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; rg -n 'timeMultiplier' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -8; rg -n -C 3 'grid\\??:|stroke\\??:|scales\\??:|interface Axis|type Axis' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -70; cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat; rg -n 'border-radius-xl|spacing-9|text-light-primary' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5; sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/GravityChartsWidget.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build -- --manifest > /tmp/spektr-build.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -12 /tmp/spektr-build.log; exit "$result"'
